description: Eclipse Strata binds fabrication authority into one Herald-grammar signed mandate (agent x printer serial x design pin x slicer build x profile hash x material x envelope x site class x window), enforced at a site bridge holding the only printer credentials. The bridge re-slices the pinned inputs at dispatch and canonical-hash-matches the toolpath before any printer contact; hand-edited toolpaths, tampered profiles, slicer drift, config drift and material swaps all refuse by name before heat. Every print and refusal seals into a Blackbox-form evidence pack (Strata Proof verifies it offline, re-deriving the chain); Strata Gauge statically checks mandates+profiles. P0 ships simulators only (OctoPrint virtual + virtual Klipper/Moonraker): no raw G-code surface (T2 refused through P2), no config writes ever (T3 permanent refusal), design registration proposes only — pin activation is a human-principal signed act. Family: Eclipse Strata Bridge (connector), Eclipse Strata (MCP), Eclipse Strata Proof + Gauge (tools).
